items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: The nearest to me that could come anywhere near him is Oscar Peterson. That's my opinion, not somebody else's.

ctx.x: How would you compare those guys to Art Tatum?

Those guys I mentioned? Oh no, it's a different category. The guys on a frame on the wall by himself. Like Duke Ellington. How can you compare? There's no comparison. The nearest to me that could come anywhere near him is Oscar Peterson. That's my opinion, not somebody else's. I mean the nearest playing that type of thing, Bill Taylor would be next.
What time did things start at the 3 Deuces?
